items.quote: In terms of profitability, at CM-2 level, if we talk about, both offline stores as well as online, gives us almost a similar profitability, post-marketing spends, if we see.

items.statement: Top 20 cities: 38% GMV from customers shopping both online and offline; online/offline ratio stable within 100-200 bps over last 3 years
items.quote: This is the first time that we had done this disclosure, in the top 20 cities, 38% of our GMV comes from customers which have an overlap of online and offline.

items.statement: No specific numerical guidance given for FY26 growth; expect to outperform industry growth of 12-14% over medium to long term
items.quote: We'll continue to deliver a better growth, compared to the industry growth.

items.statement: Top line expected to grow 20-25% in current year.
items.quote: But overall, considering the product mix and the geography and customer and all, we are thinking our top line will grow 20-25% in current year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to be in the range of 17-19%.
items.quote: Margin, EBITDA margin, we always mention. We are seeing the range amount of 17-19% EBITDA margin.

items.statement: PAT margin seen as stable at 10 to 12%.
items.quote: As far as the PAT margin is concerned, we are seeing 10 to 12% is a stable margin which we are seeing.

items.statement: Chennai total capex 48 crores; phase 1 incurred 25 crores, phase 2 balance 23 crores.
items.quote: So, as in DRHP also we disclosed, in Chennai we emphasize the total CAPEX of 48 crores in phase 1 and phase 2. In phase 1, we already incurred 25 crores and capacity is approximately 55 to 60 crores depending upon the product mix and phase 2 will be starting end of this year and next year.

items.statement: Chennai phase 2 capacity after completion around 110 to 120 crores.
items.quote: There we will be deploying the balance of 23 crores and the capacity after completion of phase 2 will be around 110 to 120 crores.

items.statement: Chennai production expected 25-30 crores in current year, 60-70 crores next year.
items.quote: In current year, we think we will be producing and delivering approximately 25 to 30 crores and in next year, targeting around 60 to 70 crores and the peak capitalization will be in FY’27.

items.statement: Total capacity after Wada and Chennai expansion around 425 to 450 crores.
items.quote: Capacity point of view, Wada and Chennai put together capacity what we will be planning to add in current year and next year with some CAPEX. We will be reaching 325 crores something in Wada and 120, 110-120 from Chennai. So, capacity point around 425 to 450 crores.

items.statement: New US fastener order has potential to supply approximately 8.5 crores every year.
items.quote: Yes, this order value having potential to supply every year approximately 8.5 crores to them.

items.statement: Vestas business expected to grow in value terms but share may decline from 23%.
items.quote: So, based on the projections and forecast, given we like to grow the business with Vestas in this year also, apart from adding new products also which are under development with them. So, we continue to grow as a revenue with Vestas. But as a percentage, maybe our share with Vestas will slowly come down, which is 23%.

items.statement: Tariffs and import duties on exports are borne by customers.
items.quote: Delivery basis, but in that when we deliver the tariffs and the duties are in the customer account, that is not the liability or in the Gala account has been put out. All the tariffs and import duties are borne by customer wherever we export globally.

items.statement: No impact seen from China tariffs; competition is with US and European manufacturers.
items.quote: Basically, in general, we feel that China tariff will be higher than India. But that doesn't impact us at all because when we supply in the U.S. market, we don't compete with Chinese manufacturers for our products of springs and fasteners.

items.statement: Exports expected to be 35-40% of revenue in FY26, similar to current level.
items.quote: More or less, 35 to 40% of the revenue which we are seeing will be there from the export market. There is a similar level of export we are expecting in FY’26 as well.

items.statement: Working capital cycle increased due to higher DSO and inventory; expected to stabilize.
items.quote: Yes, your observation is correct. There is an increase in working time in FY’25 compared to earlier year and there are two major components, the receivable and the inventory.

items.statement: Inorganic opportunities being evaluated, particularly in domestic market.
items.quote: So, as we mentioned in our last call as well, yes, we are open for inorganic opportunity as well. And the evaluation expositions are going on, particularly in the domestic market.

items.statement: New Grip Lock washer launched for construction equipment sector.
items.quote: Lastly, we have developed and launched new product, the Grip Lock washer, significantly targeted at construction equipment sector, further diversifying our product offering and market reach.

items.statement: First order secured from US industrial customer for bolt products.
items.quote: I am proud to share that we have already secured first order from an industrial customer based in the United States.

items.statement: Revenue to grow 23-25% over FY25.
items.quote: Our guidance is that we will grow our revenue by 23% to 25% over what we have achieved in March '25 and this trajectory we know can be achieved through our execution and the fact that we have order book to back up.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 12-12.25%.
items.quote: Our guidance remains the same at 12 % to 12.25% EBITDA because we know the margin profile of the order book we have which is, of course, the best in the industry as we speak.

items.statement: Capex of INR 326 crores for factory expansion and new plant.
items.quote: We had looked at INR 326 crores for our expansion of our factories and a new factory and some plant in equipment.

items.statement: Brownfield capacity by June-July, new factory by December.
items.quote: So, part capacity to the Brownfield project will happen by June -July. And a new factory which will set up, will happen by December.

items.statement: Order book with L1 of INR 15,915 crores, L1 INR 1,364 crores.
items.quote: The order book and our industry outlook, what we have today is order book with L1 of INR 15,915 crores out of which L1 is INR 1,364 crores which provides us a strong revenue visibility in the next 24 months.

items.statement: Order intake in India to be same or better than FY25.
items.quote: With the order capex plan of PowerGrid, which is itself INR 35,000 crores, we believe that we have a good chance to be at the same level or better our order intake in India.

items.statement: Bid pipeline over INR 1 lakh crores, win ratio 8-10%.
items.quote: So, the pipeline as I mentioned in the call will be around INR1 lakh -odd crores, India and international. And we are looking at 8%, 10% win ratio as we go along.

items.statement: International and domestic mix to remain 50-50.
items.quote: Our T&D business is 50-50 almost international and domestic. Internationally we only do T&D. So therefore our going forward international domestic will be almost same.

items.statement: Bangladesh order book to reduce to 5-6% by year end, finish by June 26.
items.quote: And by the year end, it will be 5% to 6% only. And we intend to finish the Bangladesh job by Juneof 26.

items.statement: No intention to bid new orders in Bangladesh currently.
items.quote: We don't intend to bid orders in Bangladesh as of now.

items.statement: Interest cost expected at 3.5-3.6% of turnover.
items.quote: Yes, it is going to be in the range of 3.5% to 3.6% of the total turnover.

items.statement: Working capital days expected 75-85 days next year.
items.quote: We expect it to be remain within 75 -85 working days in the next year, which is as per close to the industry norms.

items.statement: Tax rate to remain similar to current year.
items.quote: Tax rate will remain similar, almost in the same line of there is no change much is going to take place in the current year.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 95% towers, 100% conductors.
items.quote: So, currently we are at 95% on towers and 100% on conductors.

items.statement: Revenue mix: 92% T&D, 4% civil, 2% railways, 1% poles.
items.quote: So, predominantly, 92% is T&D, 4% is civil, 2% is railways and 1% is poles.

items.statement: HVDC pipeline around INR 5,000 crores, project timelines 24-30 months.
items.quote: So, the pipeline is around INR 5,000 crores what we hear and we see the forecast. We already got one job, that is KPS 2 to Nagpur and we are now starting work there, which we got in the last quarter.

items.statement: There is definitely scope for margin expansion.
items.quote: I think there is definitely scope for expansion

items.statement: Planned capex of close to INR68 crores from IPO proceeds, with only a small amount done last year and more deployment in the current year.
items.quote: See for now we have Rajat from our IPO proceed, we have planned for capex, which is close to INR68 crores and we have only done very small amount in the last financial year, while we are deploying more in the current year.

items.statement: A&P expenses on a full year basis can be taken at approximately 5% of sales.
items.quote: Going ahead on a full year basis, our A&P can be taken at approximately 5% of the sales.

items.statement: ESOP expenses of INR14 crores expected over the next 4 years, spread 25% each year.
items.quote: I think in the next 4 years, we are looking at about INR14 crores of ESOPs. That is in the next 4 years. All put together, spread across four years, all put together. The four year total amount is INR14 crores.

items.statement: Management is very positive about US business despite tariffs, seeing strong growth and traction.
items.quote: So we see this as a positive. If you ask us, of course, initially we were concerned, everyone was concerned, but we instantly went there, we met a lot of people, we had a lot of meetings. So we are now actually very positive about it, rather than negative about the tariffs.

items.statement: Digital penetration increased to 64% from 49% during the year.
items.quote: During the year, our digital penetration increased to 64% from 49%.

items.statement: Aligner revenue was INR77 crores for the year.
items.quote: The aligners revenue is INR77 crores total of the aligners solutions.

items.statement: Kids-e-Dental business delivered revenue of INR26 crores, EBITDA of INR15.5 crores, and PAT of INR12 crores during the year.
items.quote: Our Kids-e-Dental business delivered a revenue of INR26 crores with the EBITDA of INR15.5 crores and PAT of INR12 crores during the year.

items.statement: Received regulatory clearance for Singapore and confident to get green signals from many other countries soon.
items.quote: I am happy to share with you that recently we have got a regulatory clearance to go ahead for Singapore, and this is just the beginning and we are very confident to get green signals from many other countries soon.

items.statement: Finance cost expected to reduce considerably from Q1 FY26.
items.quote: We plan to further bring down our tax. As a result, we expect a considerable reduction in our finance cost from Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Placed orders for machine equipment and intraoral scanners in Q4 FY25.
items.quote: Post our participation in the IDS dental show in Germany, we have identified some machine equipment with cutting -edge technologies along with intraoral scanners and have placed orders for the same in this quarter.

items.statement: Expect good results in all three categories within this year from IDS leads.
items.quote: And we expect that within this year, we will see good results in all three categories. And this momentum will keep carrying forward for the next two years because some registration takes three months once we have products and services that we want to sell.

items.statement: Aligner category capacity utilization is 67%.
items.quote: Mathematical analysis, it will be 67% capacity utilization in the aligner category. That is how, what we are currently.

items.statement: Zirconia contributes more than 50% of domestic laboratory revenue and significant majority of export revenue.
items.quote: So Zirconia contributes, I would say significant majority or depends on the domestic part it's more than 50% in terms of revenue. On the export part there is a significant majority of Zirconia because there are other products as well that we do in the international market.

items.statement: Digitization can eliminate 25% to 30% of processes.
items.quote: And that is the goal right now, you know, the digitization, like I said, happy for you to come see the process , we can eliminate 25% to 30% processes with digitization and that is what is our constant strive to do.

items.statement: Expects quarterly growth similar to last year, with numbers multiplying as they go ahead.
items.quote: But one thing I can say is that there will be a quarterly growth like the way we did it last year. So that's the trend that we'll be currently committing right now. And as and when we go ahead, the numbers will only multiply.

items.statement: Won 6 new orders worth over INR100 crores over next 4-5 years, including Central Bank of India deal.
items.quote: When it comes to technology partner business, I can say that today, in about last 4, 5 months odd with all the efforts from my sales team, we got 6 new orders worth over INR100-odd crores in the next 4 to 5 years.

items.statement: Central Bank of India order is about INR70-odd crore over next 5 years.
items.quote: One of the largest deal being Central Bank of India, which is majorly because we ensured that we pivot into more areas of business and offline payment was one, which is about INR70-odd crore order in the next 5 years.

items.statement: New businesses will start showing numbers in P&L by first half of FY26.
items.quote: For all the new businesses, which I mentioned, our P&L will start showing the numbers from -- by the half yearly -- first half yearly itself in FY '26.

items.statement: Payment platform expected to return to 70-odd percent revenue share this financial year.
items.quote: And then -- so we see that we anticipate our payment platform to be going back to the same 70-odd percent revenue share this financial year, coming from 65% to 70%-odd from this particular business.

items.statement: Africa deal revenue will start hitting from Q1, with 7-8 months execution period.
items.quote: And so the execution has already started this quarter. We are expecting this is going to be 7, 8 months execution period, but the revenue will start hitting from Q1 itself and because there are milestone-based payments.

items.statement: Expects higher number in Q1 and Q2, benchmarking highest ever achieved.
items.quote: I can definitely look at a higher number coming in from Q1, Q2. But to be honest, if you benchmark it with the -- no, not exactly. So if you benchmark it with the highest number ever achieved by the company in those 2 quarters, I believe that the role is definitely going there only, if that's the direction.

items.statement: Committed quarter-on-quarter, annual, and half-yearly growth.
items.quote: I said I have committed quarter-on-quarter growth to you, I've committed annual growth also, half yearly growth also, but benchmarking it certain number -- is something that, let the results -- as and when the results come, we can do that.

items.statement: Proportion of GMV eligible for interchange will remain same, but ticket size will go down.
items.quote: That proportion will remain same, but the ticket size will go down. The proportion will remain the same.

items.statement: Per transaction realization may decrease, but volume will increase massively.
items.quote: Yes, the cost -- let's say, if your reconciliation cost is INR0.05, I may get INR0.03 or I may get about INR0.04, but the volume will increase. That is majorly because of the increase in volume happening in the market.

items.statement: MDR will increase upward as new instruments add value to the system.
items.quote: And yes, MDR will hit the business, I mean, upward and that will come as and when the instruments start adding value to the system.

items.statement: Q3 was worst and is behind us now.
items.quote: Well, I would say that Q3 was worst. It's behind us now. We have taken time.

items.statement: Talent pool to increase by about 30% incrementally, with AI implementation.
items.quote: Last year, there were about 20% addition in our talent pool. And this year, the estimated upward trend is going to be about 30-odd percent incremental talent along with the AI implementation.

items.statement: About 60-65% of new talent deployed in tech and product domain.
items.quote: So I feel that about 60%-odd, 60%, 65% or maybe more will be the tech and product domain. I think about 30%-odd of that, maybe 10%, 15% will be around sales.

items.statement: RegTech market size estimated at $2 billion for their type of service provider.
items.quote: So basis the module that we have developed right now, there is a $2 billion market size. Now it can be -- as and when the module multiplies and the market evolves, it can go beyond that also.

items.statement: Working with 3 to 4 channel partners for global expansion.
items.quote: So we have about 3 to 4 channel partners with whom we are working day in and out.
